summary: Close Popup: dismisses the popup this node lives in, sending named results and a close action back to the opener.
description: Close Popup works only inside a component shown via Show Popup: when `close` fires it removes the overlay. The `results` list declares values handed back (each becomes an input here and an output on the Show Popup node), and `closeActions` declares named reasons, each surfacing as its own signal at the opener — the mechanism for confirm/cancel semantics.
whenToUse: Every dismissal affordance inside a popup: confirm buttons, cancel crosses, backdrop clicks (via the backdrop Group's onClick). It has no effect outside a popup.

ports.results: Declared result names; each becomes a value input carried to the opener.
ports.closeActions: Named close reasons; each appears as a signal output on the opener's Show Popup node.

runtimeBehavior: The result-value inputs are generated from the `results` list on the instance — configuration-determined.
